aboutGame.title: What is Hide ur Base and Steal?
paragraphs: Hide ur Base and Steal is a Roblox game by Sutik x Tommy. Players hide a base, buy pets and collect money.
Explore the map, look for other bases and try to steal pets while protecting your own collection.
